rows.col_7: The proposed long-term Operation and Maintenance (O&M) arrangement with KTMPL is in the best commercial and strategic interest of Power Mech Projects Limited (PMPL), as it enables the Company to leverage its specialized engineering and O&M capabilities in the high-growth mineral processing sector while securing an assured, predictable revenue stream of approximately ₹371 Crore per annum (aggregating to ₹8,880.90 Crore) over a tenure of 23 years and 11 months.
